title: Judgment on the Philistines

questions.question: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck down what city?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:1 (ESV): "The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck down Gaza."

questions.question: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, waters are rising out of the..., and shall become an overflowing torrent;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:2 (ESV): "Behold, waters are rising out of the north, and shall become an overflowing torrent;"

questions.question: "They shall overflow the land and all that fills it, the city and those who dwell in it. Men shall cry out, and every... of the land shall wail."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:2 (ESV): "Men shall cry out, and every inhabitant of the land shall wail."

questions.question: "At the noise of the stamping of the hooves of his stallions, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of their... , the fathers look not back to their children..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:3 (ESV): "at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of their wheels,"

questions.question: Why do the fathers look not back to their children?
options: Because they are blinded by fear
Because they must focus on the battle
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:3 (ESV): "the fathers look not back to their children, so feeble are their hands,"

questions.question: "Because of the day that is coming to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from... and... every helper that remains."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:4 (ESV): "to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remains."

questions.question: "For the Lord is destroying the Philistines, the remnant of the coastland of... "
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:4 (ESV): "For the Lord is destroying the Philistines, the remnant of the coastland of Caphtor."

questions.question: Baldness has come upon which Philistine city?
"O remnant of their valley, how long will you... yourselves?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:5 (ESV): "O remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourselves?"

questions.question: "Ah, sword of the Lord! How long till you are... ? Put yourself into your scabbard, rest and be still!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:6 (ESV): "Ah, sword of the Lord! How long till you are quiet? Put yourself into your scabbard, rest and be still!"

questions.question: "How can it be quiet when the Lord has given it a charge? Against... and against the seashore he has appointed it."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:7 (ESV): "How can it be quiet when the Lord has given it a charge? Against Ashkelon and against the seashore he has appointed it."

questions.question: Whose "sword" is Jeremiah speaking to in verse 6?
What metaphor is used to describe the invading army from the north?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:2 (ESV): "Behold, waters are rising out of the north, and shall become an overflowing torrent;"

questions.question: Are Tyre and Sidon explicitly mentioned as losing their helper due to the destruction of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:4 (ESV): "to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remains."

key_verse_text: "Ah, sword of the Lord! How long till you are quiet? Put yourself into your scabbard, rest and be still! How can it be quiet when the Lord has given it a charge? Against Ashkelon and against the seashore he has appointed it."
